The '''Vorpa'ya system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Mandalore sector/Legends|Mandalore sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vorpa'ya]].
